posts.title: My own OS (UX/RT) now runs a shell
posts.description: If you've watched some of my earlier videos or seen my posts here or on Discord , you might have seen that I've been working on my own QNX-like OS. Up until fairly recently, UX/RT only ran hardcoded tests built into the process server and had nothing to interact with, but now I have it running a minimal shell and a few other user programs. posts.title: A new bug fix release of the Virtual OS Museum is available
posts.description: I have released an updated version of the Virtual OS Museum with various bug fixes. The new release doesn't include any new OS installations, but it does fix most of the major issues people were reporting.
